title: Eastern Wu
capsule: Eastern Wu (Sun Wu) was one of the three states of the Three Kingdoms period, founded by Sun Quan in the southeastern Yangtze region with its capital at Jianye (Nanjing). It allied with Shu Han against Cao Wei and controlled the Jiangnan heartland. It was the last of the three kingdoms to fall, conquered by the Jin dynasty in 280 AD.
